name: In Search of Anthion
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Well, nothing left for us to do but try out the goblin's invention.  Word has it that Anthion was mowed down by the undead legions of Stratholme as he tried to enter its gates.

Try using the device there and find out whatever Anthion knew.
narrative.objectives: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
narrative.offerRewardText: Deliana had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.

chain.subtitle: 33 quests at level 60, 130,500 XP in all.

quests.name: One quest for each class
quests.objectiveText: Druid, Hunter, Mage, Paladin, Priest, Rogue, Warlock, Warrior

quests.name: A Supernatural Device
quests.objectiveText: Take the Sealed Venom Container to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: A Supernatural Device
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Ectoplasmic Distiller
quests.objectiveText: Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.

quests.name: Hunting for Ectoplasm
quests.objectiveText: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Pl

quests.name: A Portable Power Source
quests.objectiveText: Find Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, obtain his Magma Core and bring it to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: A Shifty Merchant
quests.objectiveText: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Return to Deliana
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to Deliana in Ironforge.

quests.name: Return to Mokvar
quests.objectiveText: Return to Mokvar in Orgrimmar with the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer.

quests.name: One quest for each class
quests.objectiveText: Druid, Hunter, Mage, Paladin, Priest, Rogue, Warlock, Warrior

quests.name: Just Compensation
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: In Search of Anthion
quests.objectiveText: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.

quests.name: Dead Man's Plea
quests.objectiveText: Go into Stratholme and rescue Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.

quests.name: Proof of Life
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Anthion's Strange Request
quests.objectiveText: Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Anthion's Old Friend
quests.objectiveText: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.

quests.name: Falrin's Vendetta
quests.objectiveText: Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.

quests.name: The Instigator's Enchantment
quests.objectiveText: Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.

quests.name: The Challenge
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone.
